description.zh: 经典围棋，支持 19/13/9 路棋盘。完整实现气、整块提子、禁自杀与打劫，双方连续虚手后按中国规则数子法计分（黑贴 7.5 目）。支持双人对弈与人机对战（三档 AI），附带悔棋、认输与坐标棋谱。
description.en: Classic Go on 19x19, 13x13 or 9x9 boards. Full liberties, group capture, suicide ban and ko rules, with Chinese area scoring (komi 7.5) after two consecutive passes. Two-player and VS Computer modes with three AI levels, plus undo, resignation and coordinate move record.

controls.en: Click an intersection to place a stone
